Panorama.title: Research panorama
Panorama.intro: This research happens at the intersection of three fields: museology, service design and information design. The diagram below can be downloaded as an image and shared freely.
Panorama.fieldIntersection: At the intersection of the design fields
Panorama.vennAlt: Venn diagram with three circles: museology, service design and information design. This research sits at the intersection of all three.
Panorama.vennCaption: The research panorama: each field lends its tools, and the work lives where the three meet.

Collaborate.title: Collaborate
Collaborate.body: Do you work at a museum in Belo Horizonte? We want to talk. During the second half of 2026 we're taking this research into the field, and it only works with the people who run museums day to day.
Collaborate.graphicIntro: If you want to present the research to someone at your museum, this image sums up the study's strongest numbers — download and forward it freely.
Collaborate.formIntro: Tell us where you work and how we can talk. We answer everyone.
